notes:
The slice has 23 entries and 280 listed claims. 10 are findings, all class drift, and 270 are ok. Another 14 are counted but not listed. Nine are ptr: the supersedes and amends clauses of D-261, D-317, D-465, D-466, D-468 and D-471, D-432's provisional name, and D-432's two version-bump rules, which its D-467 annotation defers to the first release. Five are why: D-289's optimization-level knob and component-package workload, D-305's tolerant services and type-instability canary, and D-317's "every field used by every instance".

Annotated supersessions are filed as ok. Many Position clauses the code no longer matches carry an annotation on the entry itself, such as D-256's five fields, D-315's alias pass, D-317's interrupt clause, D-320's Dual list and D-442's RK4(h). Those rows are ok with the annotation's line cited, since the log already records the move. The 10 findings are moves that a later entry or a commit records but the entry's own annotations do not.

Leads, 18 in all. Findings: loop_acct, stop_on and stop_addrs, not_harmonic. Ok: sched, which was the Simulation field's name and is Deployment.schedule.
